The 2014–15 Missouri State Lady Bears basketball team was the women's basketball team representing Missouri State University during the 2014–15 NCAA Division I women's basketball season. The team was led by head coach Kellie Harper and played their home games at JQH Arena in Springfield, Missouri.

The Lady Bears had a successful season in 2014–15, finishing with a 24-10 overall record and a 15-3 record in the Missouri Valley Conference. They advanced to the championship game of the MVC Tournament, where they were defeated by Wichita State. Despite the loss in the conference tournament, Missouri State received an at-large bid to the NCAA Tournament.

In the NCAA Tournament, the Lady Bears were seeded 12th in the Oklahoma City region. They faced fifth-seeded Texas in the first round and pulled off a major upset, defeating the Longhorns 70-64 in overtime. However, their tournament run came to an end in the second round when they were defeated by fourth-seeded Stanford.

The team was led by standout player Kenzie Williams, who was named the MVC Player of the Year and was a key contributor on both ends of the court. Other notable players on the roster included Tyonna Snow, Liza Fruendt, and Hillary Chvatal.

Overall, the 2014–15 Missouri State Lady Bears basketball team had a successful season, making it to the NCAA Tournament and defeating a higher-seeded team in the first round. They were a competitive and talented team that represented Missouri State well throughout the season.
